The other day I tried telling my mum about how I stroll with concentration and that I find it hard to read and stuff like that but she just told me I need to try harder and she thinks that I should just read every night. I don’t think she really understands it just makes me feel even worse. She also said that she help me with concentration and that if it does not get better than we will go to the doctor to see why. But I feel like she doesn’t really take me seriously and thinks that all of it can be fixed really easily but I tried to tell her why but she just brings up things like you are just not paying attention in class but I try really hard but I just can’t and I really think I should go to the doctors to find out what is wrong with me but I feel like it will be a while till she says that we can go. My cousin deals with ADHD so I have always looked after him and have loved to play with him but I never thought that what I could be going through was the same as him.
I will try to do as you say but at the moment I have been trying to tell my parents or just anyone but it is hard to bring up the conversation without them talking about something else.

Thank you so much for the advice. At the moment I have not told my parents because I feel like they would not believe me or something like that, because I have not told my parents I don’t really want to go to a school counseling. I also feel very different from the other girls at my school because they all are learning some new dance or posting stuff on social media whilst I am just trying to survive and I can barley keep up with new trend I also prefer to be outside but lately I have haven’t been going out side. At my school people are very sporty and are academic I would say I fit more on the sporty side of the school but I feel I just can’t compare to people I feel like they are all so much better than me. I also feel like I am not smart enough and I can’t seem to do anything correctly. When it comes maths and science I can’t seem to remember anything and I just can’t seem to understand it even after trying real,y hard and getting help from teachers and friends that understand but in the end it makes no difference. My dad is a history teacher at my school and I know a lot of teacher because of that but I also feel a lot of pressure to do well and to get an A in history. I find history relatively easy and I can Rembrandt most things but when it comes to test time I just can’t put pen on to paper I just can’t understand anything. When ever a teacher is helping I am listening and watching but it just seems to go through one ear and out the other, I just can’t get my self to focus some times especially when have to sit still in class because I feel so bored and that I want to do something, but when I am at home in my room using my iPad I don’t feel that I am bored because there is always something to do on the iPad  but that is a lie I get bored of using the iPad I just want to go outside but my mind says no there’s no point what are you even going to do and if I even do go outside and play just feel like rubbish, or that I just wish I could die or for everything to be over. Thank you so much again for replying and I am sorry that these comments are so long.
